name: Inspiring Minds
summary: Ninety minutes. Adults compete on a science mystery, a locked object opens and reframes the exercise, then children arrive and the adults teach them what they just discovered. Every child leaves with their own locked kit; every partner organization leaves with a classroom collection.
source: Modeled from Inspiring Minds: Give-back program variations. Durations, ratios and scale bands are as stated there.

parameters.label: Industry variation
parameters.help: Security, software and finance take Secrets Through Time. Diagnosis, evidence or judgement takes Trace Evidence. Anyone who builds, powers or moves things takes The Long Current. Genuinely mixed rooms take Secrets Through Time.

parameters.label: Format
parameters.help: Drives staffing, AV and whether the reversal is delivered from a stage or at the table.

parameters.label: Participants (adults)
parameters.help: One pod is fifteen participants in five teams of three.

parameters.label: Young scientists (children)
parameters.help: Five per pod, one per team of three. Ages roughly 11 to 13.

parameters.label: Partner organizations
parameters.help: Each receives a classroom collection. Large events fund several.

parameters.label: Reversal delivered from a stage
parameters.help: Table-delivered below about ten pods; stage-led above.

parameters.label: Room can be dimmed
parameters.help: Required for the signal station in The Long Current.

parameters.label: Hard deadline: children must depart by
parameters.help: Set this and the whole ninety minutes is placed backward from it.

parameters.label: How to describe the client to the partner organization
Who meets the children on arrival

quantities.basis: fifteen participants and five children per pod; whichever count needs more pods wins
one set of five stations per pod

quantities.note: Trace Evidence only. Water logistics start to lead the plan beyond about forty pods.
Stated for a department day. Conference and general sessions use zone captains instead; confirm against the format.

quantities.basis: the program is built on three to one
quantities.note: Three to one is fixed at every size. A number materially below three means either the participant count or the child count is wrong.

resources.label: Venue
resources.note: Venue provides tables and chairs, power, and dimmable lighting where the variation needs it.

resources.label: Partner organization
resources.note: The partner organization coordinates arrival, consent, chaperones and transport. Arrival is timed to minute 35 regardless of scale.

resources.label: AV and staging
resources.note: AV is needed above roughly ten pods, with a countdown clock for stage-led timing.

resources.label: Kit production
resources.note: Lead time is three weeks to around thirty pods, six to eight weeks beyond that.

run_of_show.anchor_rule: The reveal happens once, for the whole room, at minute thirty, and the children join at minute thirty-five regardless of scale. If the engagement has a hard departure deadline for the children, the ninety minutes is placed backward from it; otherwise it runs forward from participant arrival.

main_track.label: Load-in and setup
details: Station tables laid per pod, five stations each
Pod locked objects placed with something visibly inside
Child kits staged out of sight
Power and lighting checked
AV and countdown clock where the format needs it

main_track.label: Participants arrive and are seated
details: Teams of three, pre-assigned and mixed across departments
Five teams to a pod

main_track.label: The Mission: the mystery
details: The locked object is introduced and nothing else is explained
Five teams take five cases off the table
No lecture. There is a clock.

main_track.label: Investigate: discovery
details: Phones encouraged
Prompts point toward the answer without giving it
Each team becomes the only expert on its station

main_track.label: Converge: the opening
details: Five separate discoveries become one combination
One piece is deliberately missing and the room supplies it together
The object opens

main_track.label: The Reversal: prepare to inspire
details: Inside is a rolled message: special guests are arriving
The real challenge is to inspire a young mind, and there are five minutes
Competitors become teachers in the space of one sentence

main_track.label: Inspire: the young scientists
details: One child joins each team of three
The child does the experiment; the adults build the conditions for discovery
The adult never takes the materials back
Then each child presents what they found

main_track.label: Continue: the second reveal
details: Every child receives their own locked object, already locked, combination withheld
Solve it, reset it, and build a mystery for someone else
Field book and journal handed over with the kit

main_track.label: Load-out and classroom collections handed over
details: Classroom collection handed to each partner organization
Station kits repacked

beneficiary_track.label: Partner organization confirms arrival time, consent, chaperones and transport
Children arrive and go to the holding area, out of sight of the room
Chaperones and Be Legendary staff run the holding area with drinks
Children briefed and lined up outside the room
Children enter and join their team of three
Each child presents what they found
Child kits presented: locked object, field book, journal

cost_lines.label: Child kits, field books and journals

documents.title: {{beneficiary_org}} coordination letter
documents.purpose: Sent about four weeks out. Tells the school or youth organization when to arrive, how many young scientists to bring, what they will do, and what the organization keeps afterwards.

body: It was a pleasure speaking with you about our {{name}} program. We are very excited to have the {{beneficiary_org}} involved.
Here are some details for you...

sections.heading: WHEN
body: {{delivery_date}}
Children arrive on site at {{arrive_venue_time}} and depart at approximately {{depart_venue_time}}
They are in the room with the adults from {{enter_time}}

sections.heading: WHERE
body: {{venue_name}}
{{venue_address}}
{{venue_phone}}
The holding area is {{holding_room}}. I will be in touch the day before and the day of the event to confirm.

sections.heading: WHO
body: {{client_descriptor}} is running a {{format}} for {{participants}} people. {{name}} is the session, and the children are the reason it works.
We are asking for {{beneficiaries}} young scientists, roughly {{age_min}} to {{age_max}} years old. Each child joins a team of three adults, so there are three adults for every child.

sections.heading: WHAT THE CHILDREN WILL DO
body: For the first thirty minutes the adults work on a science mystery without knowing the children are coming. Then a locked object opens and they find out that the real challenge is to inspire a young mind.

Your young scientists then join the teams. The child does the experiment; the adults build the conditions for discovery and never take the materials back. Each child presents what they found to the room.
This variation is {{variation}}.

sections.heading: WHAT EVERY CHILD TAKES HOME
body: Every child leaves with their own reusable field case holding their own locked object, already locked, with the combination withheld. Inside are five secrets, one per station. They solve them, work out the last one, and open it.
With it travels a field book carrying each experiment rebuilt from household objects, and a journal whose first page reads: scientists don't just collect answers, they collect questions.
The instruction that matters is the last one. Reset the lock, choose a new combination, and build a mystery for a brother, a friend, a classroom.

sections.heading: WHAT THE {{beneficiary_org}} KEEPS
body: The children in the room should not be the only beneficiaries. Your organization receives a classroom collection: additional locked objects, the full stories, the science behind each one, the station kits themselves, consumables to run the sequence repeatedly through the year, a facilitator guide, and further experiments that extend past the day.
This is what turns a corporate afternoon into a term of science teaching.

sections.heading: WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU
bullets: Their first names and ages once your list is set.
The names of the staff who will accompany them.
Arrival at {{arrive_venue_time}}. The timing matters: if the children are seen before the adults open the locked object, the moment the whole program turns on is lost.

sections.heading: TRANSPORT
body: We are expecting {{beneficiary_transport_by}} to provide transportation of the children to and from the venue.

sections.heading: ON ARRIVAL
body: {{greeter_name}} will meet you and walk you to the holding area. We will provide drinks for the children while they wait, and our staff will brief them on what is about to happen.
The children should be on their way by approximately {{depart_venue_time}}.

sections.heading: A NOTE ON THE CHILDREN
body: The {{beneficiary_org}} retains legal custody and responsibility for the children throughout the event. Be Legendary staff supervise the children while they are in our care at the venue, in coordination with your staff. Please plan to have your staff with the children at all times.

sections.heading: THANK YOU
body: Thank you so much for being a part of this. The adults in that room came to be inspired by each other and leave inspired by your young people instead, which is the part nobody predicts.
Please don't hesitate to contact me with any questions or concerns.
